postflight_workspace.allocated_semantics: observed sum st_blocks*512, deduplicated hardlinks; Btrfs shared extents may be counted more than once
postflight_workspace.limitations: No atomic snapshot/quota backend. A traversal can miss creates/growth/mmap/replacements between observations; no upper bound or verified lifetime peak. One pass, no retry. Deadline is cooperative, not a bound on one blocked kernel syscall.
postflight_workspace.mutation_observer: bounded per-pass inotify; not independent capacity proof; mmap/writeback not covered

postflight_workspace_capacity.independent_capacity_upper_bound_semanti: Btrfs qgroup max referenced bytes, scoped to registered subvolume
postflight_workspace_capacity.proof_semantics: root-attested Btrfs squota max-referenced bound; not a physical-device bound; retained-disk reserve remains enforced

source_of_authority: Ten successful B3.1 arm-before receipts and their analysis preserved in the canonical M4 handoff and result artifacts; this is empirical successful-run evidence, not a universal host-safety standard

watchdog_summary.final_cgroup_sampling: captured while transient unit remains active after ExecStart; systemd unit is stopped after this receipt is durable
watchdog_summary.memory_stat_peak_semantics: per-field maxima may come from different samples; not an atomic decomposition of memory.current
watchdog_summary.sampling_scope: external watchdog; live kernel qgroup capacity sampled; workspace inventory and soft-budget peaks UNKNOWN
watchdog_summary.workspace_capacity_bound_semantics: root-attested Btrfs squota max referenced bytes; excludes host/global metadata/chunk overhead

workspace_shared_extent_inspection.reason: No extra recursive FIEMAP walk in bounded observer; extent sharing unknown, never capacity proof

watchdog_summary.workspace_snapshot_semantics: workspace inventory NOT sampled; live qgroup capacity samples only; soft-budget peaks UNKNOWN
